# Al Kabir Lighting LLC

Al Kabir Lighting is the premier Lighting, Electrical & Building Material Partner in the Sultanate of Oman. We specialize in providing comprehensive, high-quality solutions for commercial, industrial, and infrastructure developments.

## Core Products
- **LED Downlights & Panel Lights**: For offices, hospitality, and residential projects.
- **Track Lights & Linear Lights**: Architectural lighting for retail spaces and galleries.
- **Street & Landscape Lighting**: Urban infrastructure, pathway lighting, and smart-city integrated luminaires.
- **Industrial & Explosion Proof**: High-bay lights and specialized ATEX-certified luminaires for hazardous environments.
- **Solar Lighting**: Autonomous off-grid solar street and pathway lights.

## Engineering Capabilities
- Dialux 3D Photometric Simulation (Lux calculations, false-color heatmaps, glare UGR analysis).
- Consultant Submittal Preparation.
- BOQ Take-Off & Value Engineering.
- Sample Coordination & Mockups.
